# Alterity

> Alterity is an AI voice agent platform for business calls in India. Every call runs through a designed IVR flow - keypad menus, playback and digit capture where a fixed path works, an AI voice agent at the steps where a caller's need goes beyond a menu, and a handoff to your team with the recording and transcript when a person should take over. Alterity agents call end to end in 11 Indian languages - Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia and Urdu - plus English and mainstream foreign languages, and can switch between Hindi and English within a call. Alterity's orchestration engine delivers sub-400ms responses.

## Pricing
- Flat ₹4 per connected minute, exclusive of GST - up to 30 seconds bills as 30 seconds, 31 to 60 seconds bills as a full minute, beyond that per second. No setup fee, no minimum monthly commitment. Speech-to-text, the language model, the voice, telephony and analytics are bundled. Committed monthly volumes move to a custom enterprise plan.
- Pricing: https://www.alterity.io/pricing
- Pricing comparison: https://www.alterity.io/pricing-comparison
- Cost calculator: https://www.alterity.io/calculator
